title: The Goblin Warren
objective: Fight through the goblin warren to the boss's hall, take its hoard, and get back out alive. Leave by the gate when you are ready.

rooms.name: Warren Gate
rooms.description: A rough tunnel mouth in a hillside, hung with bones and rags. Daylight is at your back.

features.name: Bone Charms
features.description: Strings of small bones rattle across the tunnel mouth.
features.discovery: Scratched on a thigh bone in goblin marks: a guard in the tunnel, the boss beyond.

rooms.name: Guard Tunnel
rooms.description: A low tunnel lit by a smoking brazier, littered with gnawed bones.

features.name: Smoking Brazier
features.description: An iron brazier of greasy smoke, too hot to touch.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid on a cord.

rooms.name: Boss's Hall
rooms.description: A wide cave heaped with stolen goods, with a throne of stacked crates at its far end.

features.name: Crate Throne
features.description: Crates stacked into a lopsided throne, draped with a moth-eaten cloak.
features.discovery: Under the cloak is a sack, heavy and clinking.

items.name: Sack of Stolen Coins
items.description: A sack of mixed coins taken from travellers on the road.

items.name: Silver Chain of Office
items.description: A heavy silver chain the boss wore as a badge of rank.

passages.description: The tunnel runs down into smoke.
A wider passage opens into a hall.

opponents.name: Goblin Warrior
opponents.description: A goblin guard, a vial swinging at its neck, leaps up from the brazier with its scimitar drawn.

opponents.name: Goblin Boss
opponents.description: The goblin boss rises from its crate throne, a silver chain at its neck.

endings.title: Out with the hoard
endings.text: You climb out of the warren into the daylight, the boss's treasure on your back.

endings.title: Out of the warren
endings.text: You climb out of the warren into the daylight with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Fallen in the warren
endings.text: You fall among the gnawed bones. Your adventuring ends here.
